technique: Make merged switch arms textually different the way the original was, for example one arm reads through a pointer to the va_list home slot, so the compiler cannot cross-jump them.
example:
case 1: f(ap); break;
case 2: { char **p = ≈ f(*p); } break;
detect: candidate_bytes < target and difflib delete runs of equal length repeated

technique: Declare a block-local pointer inside the branch so loop hoisting cannot keep sp+const live in a register for the whole function.
detect: extra callee-saved/spill slot; register holds sp+const across loop

technique: Probe with -dg -dl and compute floor_log2(refs)*refs/live per pseudo from the lreg dump, then change live ranges or first use: goto loops drop loop-depth weight, test-before-copy removes weighted refs, reorder case assignments.
A rodata reference that is off by exactly 4 against the target means an 8-byte constant item must align against the final address. Fix it in the link step, not in C.
detect: placement problem 'references to .rdata disagree' with two bases 4 apart

technique: When the target repeats a block body, write the block out twice instead of sharing it with goto. Split one goto into separate if-blocks.
example:
if (a) { x = f(); y = g(x); }
if (b) { x = f(); y = g(x); }
detect: target has two identical instruction runs, candidate one

technique: If the frame is smaller than the target and only sp offsets differ, add unused locals sized to the original frame and mark the function with a fakematch comment.
detect: typed.immediate on sp-relative offsets only; addiu sp delta differs

technique: Where loops use pointer increments but the target uses indexes (or the reverse), drop -fno-strength-reduce and write plain indexed for-loops.
detect: addiu on pointer regs in loop vs sll/addu index

technique: Identify the source family (BSD vfprintf, libultra, SDK GBI macros) and write the function the way that source was written.
detect: jump table on char-32, PAD 16-byte tables, mul.d/div.d by 10

technique: After hundreds of source variants with no gain, try per-file build options such as -G8 before more C rewrites.
Write a shared tail out in both arms and goto only the loop latch. The compiler cross-jumps it later but the duplicate sets raise the variable's ref count so it wins the callee-saved register.
example: if (r == 0) { best = i; }  /* in both arms */
detect: -dg -dl: chosen pseudo refs 5/live 257 loses to hoisted pointer 5/190; two arms share a goto tail

technique: Split one variable into two, such as a call result and a destination id, to lower its refs/live below the competing pseudo and swap the callee-saved registers.
example:
int res = f();
int dst = res;
detect: pri table from -dg -dl lreg: floor_log2(refs)*refs/live of the two pseudos

technique: Use real struct assignment so the compiler emits block-move loops whose end pointers are hoisted into the preheader. Keep a single explicit pointer assigned inside the loop head.
detect: asm: addiu t,sp,N / s1,80 stores to stack at function top instead of loop preheader

technique: Store the literal once after the merge point instead of assigning a flag variable in every arm.
detect: li to a0/a2 in each arm, store after merge uses same reg

technique: Declare a block-local pointer to the array inside the inner loop body and read through it instead of indexing the array or using a function-scope pointer.
detect: extra sw tX,N(sp) before the outer loop and lw aX,N(sp) in the inner loop; candidate frame > target

technique: Write the loops as plain indexed for-loops and drop -fno-strength-reduce so the compiler builds the walker pointers itself.
example: for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { a[i].x = b[i].x; }
detect: target has per-array walker pointers advancing by 4 and 12 that the candidate lacks, or candidate bytes larger

technique: Switch on an s32 instead of u8 and add the missing case labels (case 2: default:, case 0: default:) so the case tree has the same shape as the target.
example: switch ((s32)v) { case 0: default: break; case 1: f(); break; }
detect: target switch compiles to bltz/slti/bnez chain; candidate to slti/beqz/bgez

technique: Assign results back into the same C variable instead of declaring new locals, so the target's in-place float register reuse appears.
detect: candidate allocates fresh f regs where target overwrites the same one

technique: If register diffs sit in a region where a helper was inlined, pass and return by value first to remove the spill, then write the helper body directly in the caller so the compiler sees one flat web.
detect: diffs confined to the region where the helper was inlined; pointer arg gives &local on stack, size +N

technique: When a draft fails to compile with 'no member named', write a small local header with only the needed structs at the offsets read from the target disassembly (lw/lb offsets) and include it from the probe source.
example: struct Probe { u8 pad0[0x14]; s32 field14; };
